content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from themSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inthemVerified•FollowMore optionsthemVerified 3dDan Levy is back with a new show, Big Mistakes. The crime comedy, co-created by Levy and Rachel Sennott, tells the sometimes tense but always funny story of two siblings, Nicky Dardano (Levy) and Morgan Dardano (Taylor Ortega), who unexpectedly find themselves bumbling through what a promotional tagline accurately describes as “disorganized crime.”But Big Mistakes is nothing like Schitt’s Creek. While this is still a story about family, albeit one that’s far more dysfunctional than it is endearing, it takes on a more tense story that will have you on the edge of your seat. “I wanted this to be, like, a real thrill ride. I wanted people to have fun.
